assessmentName: Western Gulf Coastal Plain reference assessment
author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 0 of 14 stations of this ecoregion pass. 0 reference curves use local stations, 11 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 15 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.  No station of this ecoregion passes the reference screen, so every reference curve here borrows its reference stations from a parent ecoregion.
